releaseNotes:
• Liquid Frosted Glass Design System: Complete visual overhaul featuring specular rim borders, frosted glass surfaces, and natural spring physics
• Redesigned Core Dialogs: Translucent modals for Agent Settings, Sandbox Setup & Warning, and Daily Streak tracker
• Modern Navigation & Panels: Floating frosted action bars, liquid keyboard accessory bar, and glass file explorer
• Dynamic Dark & Light Contrast: Inverted specular highlights for optimal contrast and readability across all themes
